profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with a passion for applying technology and analytical skills to solve real-world problems in various industries.

I am interested in product-driven software development and am motivated by the opportunity to learn new skills, collaborate with diverse teams, and contribute to impactful projects that can make a positive difference in the world.

positions.title: Technology Consulting Intern
positions.description:
Supported Data and Analytics and PMO teams by leveraging SQL, Excel, and ADO to provide real-time burn-up metrics for training schedules
Created translations of SAP S/4 Hana trainings across 6 different work streams for use in over 20 countries world-wide
positions.insights: Skills: Enterprise Software · SAP Products · Analytical Skills · SAP ERP · SAP Implementation · SAP HANA · Project Management Office (PMO) · Azure DevOps Server · Communication

positions.title: Technical Product Management Intern
positions.description:
Owned automation software development for business updates to executive leadership on various internal software products. Responsibilities included:
-  Conducted user research to understand and document pain points and use cases
-  Brainstormed and designed solution wireframes on Figma and planned development process
-  Scoped technical work and designed task, stories, and acceptance requirements to build prototype

Worked as product manager intern for Space Logistics software team. Responsibilities included:
-  Translated user-facing documentation into technical requirements and a development plan for the end of Q1 and beginning of Q2
-  Facilitated UI/UX review meetings and synthesized feedback into a development plan
-  Created dashboard for the team to report real-time burndown metrics on the various products in development
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · User Stories · Jira · Analytical Skills · Agile Methodologies · Tableau · Communication · Product Management · Figma (Software)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed script to convert brain axon annotation data into tiff format to complete the iterative active learning pipeline
Designed and created revision tracking for the lab's brain mapping initiative

positions.title: Commission Manager
positions.description:
Collaborate with Academic Affairs Commission to enforce a Race and Ethnicity course requirement for the Nursing, Kinesiology, and Architecture schools beginning Fall 2021
Research Race and Ethnicity course requirements for various Big10 schools
Organize various Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion-related projects by running committee
group meetings

positions.title: Committee Member
positions.description:
Establish a food pantry on campus to combat food insecurity
Research effective food pantry layouts and necessities to create an action plan to open the
food pantry for Winter 2021

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Utilized Python, TypeScript, and CSS to calculate, analyze, and create top line ridership/service levels statistics for TM Covid Recovery Dashboard

positions.title: AI/Machine Learning Trainee
positions.description:
Created the AitherBulb: an auto-adjusting lightbulb that incorporates Light and Chromotherapy to counter-balance the user's emotions.

Won 2nd Place in VAIL 2021 Makeathon!

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Implemented nano-particle therapy by synthesizing nano-particles
Measured effectiveness of nano-particle therapy delivery through dynamic light scattering
techniques

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Researched molecular mechanisms that regulate aging processes through BCA assays and maintenance of ​Caenorahditis elegans
Tracked SKN-1 in ​Caenorahditis elegans​ to measure its effects on biological functions

honors.title: 2nd Place in VAIL 2021 Makeathon
honors.description: As part of a small team of 4, we created an automatically-adjusting lightbulb that incorporates Light- and Chromo- therapy. This lightbulb adjusts color and brightness based on the user's emotions and extent of emoting. Using Machine Learning Models we created a demo of the AitherBulb and pitched our product to a panel of 4 judges where we went on to place 2nd.
